import tempfile

def test_unique_temp():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="c2-ti-") as root:
        assert root.is_dir()

def test_result():
    result = run_fixture()
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.stdout == "passed"

import subprocess

def make_fixture_repo(tmp_path):
    repo, hooks = tmp_path / "repo", tmp_path / "hooks"
    hooks.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", str(repo)], check=True)
    for key, value in (("user.name", "Fixture"), ("user.email", "fixture@example.invalid"),
                       ("commit.gpgsign", "false"), ("core.hooksPath", str(hooks))):
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "config", "--local", key, value], check=True)
    assert list(hooks.iterdir()) == []
    return repo

def verify():
    result = subprocess.run(["verify"], check=False)

import tempfile

def test_clean_fixture():

        assert root.startswith("/")
